name: openbb_fixedincome_ice_bofa
description:
ICE BofA bond index series (yield, yield to worst, total return or option-adjusted spread) from FRED through the OpenBB Platform (obb.fixedincome.bond_indices).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): category (us, high_yield or emerging_markets; default us); index (default corporate); index_type (yield, yield_to_worst, total_return or oas; default yield); start_date; end_date; limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fred; default fred).
Spreads: fred_high_yield_spread, fred_credit_spread; Moody's Aaa and Baa yields: fred_custom_series (AAA, BAA). Keys: fred uses SAJHA's FRED_API_KEY.
Example: {"category": "high_yield", "index_type": "oas", "start_date": "2026-01-01"}

index.description: Index within the family, e.g. corporate, seasoned_corporate, yield_curve, high_yield, crossover, public_sector, private_sector

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
